Rachel Goldman
Senior Data Platform Engineer
New York, NY | rachel.goldman@datamail.io | +1 212-555-0155 | linkedin.com/in/rachelgoldman-data | github.com/rachelgoldman-etl

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Senior Data Engineer with 7+ years of experience designing robust data lakes, real-time streaming architectures, and enterprise analytics pipelines using Snowflake, dbt, Apache Spark, and Apache Airflow. Specialized in building modular data models, ELT/ETL automation, data governance, and database performance tuning. Engineered scalable data pipelines processing 15TB+ daily data while decreasing warehouse compute spend by 40%.

WORK EXPERIENCE
Senior Data Engineer | DataSphere Analytics | New York, NY | 2021 - Present
- Architected enterprise modern data stack using Snowflake, dbt Core, Apache Airflow, and AWS S3, serving analytics to 400+ business stakeholders.
- Redesigned 250+ legacy SQL queries into modular dbt dimensional models (Kimball methodology), decreasing pipeline runtime by 55% and saving $180K annually in Snowflake compute credits.
- Built real-time streaming data ingestion pipeline with Apache Kafka and Spark Streaming, reducing dashboard data latency from 24 hours to 45 seconds.
- Implemented Great Expectations data quality validation framework, catching 99.4% of data anomalies prior to executive reporting consumption.
- Established automated CI/CD for dbt models with GitHub Actions and SQLFluff linter, eliminating data schema drift across production environments.

Data Engineer | OmniRetail Insights | Jersey City, NJ | 2018 - 2021
- Developed batch ETL pipelines in Python and Apache Spark on AWS EMR, ingesting 8TB daily point-of-sale data across 1,200 retail stores.
- Managed and optimized Amazon Redshift and PostgreSQL data warehouse clusters, implementing sorting and distribution keys to improve query speed by 48%.
- Built automated data reconciliation workflows that reconciled $80M in daily financial transactions with zero discrepancy.
- Collaborated with Data Science teams to build automated feature ingestion pipelines for customer churn and lifetime value (LTV) models.

EDUCATION
Bachelor of Science in Computer Science & Applied Mathematics | Columbia University | 2014 - 2018

TECHNICAL SKILLS
- Data Warehouses & Lakes: Snowflake, Google BigQuery, Amazon Redshift, Delta Lake, AWS S3
- Processing & Streaming: Apache Spark, PySpark, Apache Kafka, Kafka Streams, Flink, dbt (Data Build Tool)
- Orchestration & Automation: Apache Airflow, Dagster, Prefect, GitHub Actions, Docker, Terraform
- Languages & Databases: Python, SQL (Advanced), Scala, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis, MongoDB
- Data Governance & Quality: Great Expectations, Monte Carlo, DataHub, Schema Registry, Git

CERTIFICATIONS
- Snowflake Certified SnowPro Core (2023)
- dbt Certified Developer (2022)
- AWS Certified Data Analytics - Specialty (2021)
jobDescriptionText:
Seeking a Senior Data Engineer to architect our enterprise data warehouse. Requirements:
- 5+ years data engineering experience with Snowflake, dbt, and Python/SQL.
- Strong experience with Apache Airflow orchestration and Apache Spark data processing.
- Expertise in data modeling (dimensional/Kimball), data quality testing, and AWS data stacks.
- SnowPro or AWS Data Analytics certification preferred.
